People Ops Bot: Heads-up: hiring update for Core Capacity team — new Sr. IC and interim lead details below. Docs + org chart: https://redwood.app/people-ops/hiring/2245019876 :tada:
Aisha Khan: Quick summary: we hired Jordan Park as Sr. Platform Engineer (IC) and Marco will cover eng manager duties as interim lead while we run the backfill process. Jordan starts Mon, May 12.
Marco Liu: Thanks! I’ll post a short ramp plan for Jordan tomorrow. Will need onboarding access to the dedicated pool and the internal runbooks.
Carmen Ortiz: Welcome Jordan! Can we confirm relocation / remote status? Also will there be a buddy?
Aisha Khan: Jordan is remote (US-PST) and will be onboarded by Carmen as buddy for the first 4 weeks. Travel for syncs is optional.
Evan Carter: Noted — Marco, please add Jordan to the capacity rotation calendar and the infra pager for observational shadowing.
Marco Liu: Done. Added to rotation and shadowing schedule. Also gave temporary perms for dev clusters (expires in 30 days).
Priya Natarajan: Awesome work getting this across the line. Any changes to headcount approvals or reqs we should know about?
Aisha Khan: Headcount is reallocated from a previously open Platform req (approved Q1). We’re publishing the backfill req this Friday; recruiting lead is Lina Chavez.
Lina Chavez: Recruiting here — candidate packet and initial interview loop will be public in Lever by EOD Friday. Please flag any must-have interviewers.
Carmen Ortiz: Can we add someone from the runtime team for kernel/quantization tech screen?
Marco Liu: Recommend Evan + Priya for the runtime screen, Carmen for culture, and Aisha for hire sign-off.
Aisha Khan: Hiring timeline: shortlist by May 26, on-sites early June, offer by June 15 (tentative). Ping me if any calendar conflicts.
Priya Natarajan: Suggest we include a short eval of production rollout experience as a take-home (48hr) — helps filter for SRE-facing decisions.
Lina Chavez: Good idea — I’ll add that to the loop.
Evan Carter: FYI: capacity roadmap hit last week, so we may want to prioritize applicants with autoscaling and batching experience.
Marco Liu: Agreed. Also planning a quick canary project for Jordan in Week 2 to get code ownership established.
Carmen Ortiz: On onboarding checklist: 1) access to dedicated pool infra 2) observability dashboard walkthru 3) eval dataset + prompts 4) meet & greets with runtime and product — assigning these to me and Marco.
Aisha Khan: Thanks Carmen. I’ll schedule the meet & greets and share the 30/60/90 expectations doc.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: update new-hire channel and badge order form within 48h of first day.
Jordan Park (guest): Thanks everyone — excited to join! Quick q: who do I ping for workstation setup?
Marco Liu: Ping Carmen for hardware, and IT will follow up with a ticket. Welcome aboard, Jordan :)
Carmen Ortiz: I’ll open the IT ticket after this thread. Welcome! :wave: 
Aisha Khan: Closing note: if you need to change interviewer commitments, update Lina asap. We'll track progress in the hiring board. :thumbsup:
